svg.title: Inclusion matrix
svg.desc: Which content each tier already covers, from Light through Ultimate plus TIF, marked as fully, partially or not included.

g.aria-label: What is already covered before you add anything
Partial coverage increases: orange = less · yellow = more · green = most
Mini variants match their non-Mini tier’s scope, just size-optimized
TIF overlaps partly with Normal through Ultimate, but no main tier includes the full feed
